01 / ORIENTATION

Know where to start

WHERE TO GO   /   Overview

Read the result message after saving or applying an action. A selection alone does not apply changes.

  1. Choose a quick action

    Use Review file inbox, Create a resource, Upload exam PDFs or Find a student to begin a common task.

  2. Open a review card

    Click Review records to open the matching list. Drafts, extracted files and unassigned questions are different tasks.

  3. Check processing & delivery

    Scroll down for Failed, Overdue and Stale claims. Select a count to inspect the records behind it.

RememberCounts can overlap. A zero count does not prove the background worker is running.
Done whenYou can identify the next task and open the correct filtered list.
UNIPORTAL / ADMIN FIELD GUIDEContents ↗03 / 20
02 / LEARNING MATERIALS

Turn an upload into a draft

WHERE TO GO   /   Content → File inbox

Read the result message after saving or applying an action. A selection alone does not apply changes.

  1. Find the source file

    Search by filename or caption. Use Filters to show processed, unassigned files. Assigned files are hidden by default.

  2. Select the reviewed file

    Tick the row checkbox. Open its filename first if you need to inspect its processing result or extracted text.

  3. Create the draft

    In Actions choose Create draft resources — assign courses and review next, then Go. One draft opens directly; a batch opens its review list.

RememberProcessed means extraction finished. A new draft is still pending and is not yet visible to students.
Done whenA pending resource exists and is ready for course assignment and file review.
UNIPORTAL / ADMIN FIELD GUIDEContents ↗04 / 20
02 / LEARNING MATERIALS

Review the resource itself

WHERE TO GO   /   Content → Resources → open a draft

Read the result message after saving or applying an action. A selection alone does not apply changes.

  1. Make the title useful

    Use a clear title that tells a student what the material contains. Confirm that the correct file is attached.

  2. Open the actual document

    Select Open file for review. Check the subject, legibility, completeness and whether the material belongs to the selected course.

  3. Continue down the form

    Scroll to File type, Source and Courses. Choose the appropriate type and source; search for each active course the file belongs to.

RememberAn existing file reference does not guarantee the file opens. Preview it before publishing. If a new upload has no preview yet, save it as Pending first.
Done whenYou have checked the actual file and know its correct course assignment.
UNIPORTAL / ADMIN FIELD GUIDEContents ↗05 / 20
02 / LEARNING MATERIALS

Publish only after review

WHERE TO GO   /   Content → Resources → Access & Status

Read the result message after saving or applying an action. A selection alone does not apply changes.

  1. Check the course tags

    At least one assigned course must be active. A course assignment and a department placement serve different purposes.

  2. Keep the free adoption policy

    Choose Free for the current adoption period. Do not introduce new paid-access rules while doing routine content work.

  3. Choose the visibility

    Leave Pending to finish later, or choose Published — visible to students once the file is reviewed.

  4. Save the change

    Press Save. For several reviewed drafts, select them in Resources and use Publish selected reviewed drafts → Go.

RememberBulk publishing skips entries that are not pending, have no file reference or have no active course. Read the success/skipped message.
Done whenThe reviewed resource is Published and attached to the correct active course.
UNIPORTAL / ADMIN FIELD GUIDEContents ↗06 / 20
02 / LEARNING MATERIALS

Find courses missing material

WHERE TO GO   /   Content → Resource coverage

Read the result message after saving or applying an action. A selection alone does not apply changes.

  1. Set your scope

    Search for a course and filter by department or program. Apply the filters before interpreting the coverage numbers.

  2. Choose the missing-material view

    Open Missing published material to see courses that still need student-visible resources.

  3. Follow the next action

    Review materials opens the course’s files. Create resource starts a new resource with that course selected. Review and publish to close the gap.

RememberOnly Published material counts as coverage. A draft alone does not make a course covered. Placements determine department/program scope.
Done whenYou know which courses need material and can open the relevant review or creation screen.
UNIPORTAL / ADMIN FIELD GUIDEContents ↗07 / 20
03 / EXAMS

Choose the right exam term

WHERE TO GO   /   Exams & quizzes → Exam terms

Read the result message after saving or applying an action. A selection alone does not apply changes.

  1. Find or create the term

    Search by center or year. Use the header + button to add a term when needed, then check year, term and center.

  2. Confirm the active term

    Use the row’s Activate control only for the term that should be current. Activating one term deactivates the others.

  3. Check imported records

    Student and PDF totals help confirm the term. Open it, scroll to Quick Actions and choose Upload and Process Exam PDFs.

RememberThe year label uses the Ethiopian calendar. Exam start date is read-only here and is derived from imported schedule sessions. Verify the imported dates.
Done whenThe intended term and center are identified, and the correct term is active.
UNIPORTAL / ADMIN FIELD GUIDEContents ↗08 / 20
03 / EXAMS

Upload schedules, then attendance

WHERE TO GO   /   Overview → Upload exam PDFs; or Exam term → Quick Actions → Upload and Process Exam PDFs

Read the result message after saving or applying an action. A selection alone does not apply changes.

  1. Upload the schedule first

    Choose the official schedule PDF. It establishes sessions and course/room information. Wait for it to complete before attendance imports.

  2. Add attendance PDFs next

    Choose the attendance files for the intended term. Press Upload and queue PDFs once you have checked the selection.

  3. Watch the result

    Use Queued, Processing, Completed and Failed counts. Refresh status checks again; recent-upload rows show created/updated counts and errors.

RememberUse the per-file limit displayed on the page. Uploading queues work; it does not finish the import. Review failed imports before retrying. Known duplicate uploads may be skipped.
Done whenThe expected imports are Completed and their records and dates have been reviewed.
UNIPORTAL / ADMIN FIELD GUIDEContents ↗09 / 20
04 / QUESTIONS & QUIZZES

Prepare an exam paper

WHERE TO GO   /   Exams & quizzes → Exam papers

Read the result message after saving or applying an action. A selection alone does not apply changes.

  1. Find the right paper

    Search by title, course or department. Check exam type and year so you do not add questions to the wrong paper.

  2. Create or open a paper

    Use the header + button or open its title. Final Exam and Team Quiz use a Course; Exit Exams use a Department.

  3. Check readiness

    Review the active question count and set a duration. Keep access Free during adoption and enable the paper only when it is ready.

RememberFor spreadsheet imports, open a paper and scroll to Quick Actions → Import Questions from Excel. Download that page’s template, keep its columns and upload the workbook. Imported questions start inactive.
Done whenThe paper has the correct ownership, duration and a reviewed set of questions.
UNIPORTAL / ADMIN FIELD GUIDEContents ↗10 / 20
04 / QUESTIONS & QUIZZES

Assign and review a question

WHERE TO GO   /   Exams & quizzes → Questions → open a question

Read the result message after saving or applying an action. A selection alone does not apply changes.

  1. Read the full question

    Compare the wording with the source. Correct extraction errors and make sure the question can be understood on its own.

  2. Choose the correct type

    Set the question type before editing answer fields. Multiple choice, true/false, matching, fill blank and essay use different answer formats.

  3. Assign the exam paper

    Choose the intended paper. A question without a paper needs assignment before it can be used in that paper.

  4. Check the chapter

    Choose a chapter that belongs to the same course as the paper. Then continue to the options and explanation below.

RememberAI output is a draft. From File inbox, Extract questions from selected files using AI queues extraction; then review the resulting questions and paper assignments.
Done whenThe wording, question type, paper and chapter have been checked against the source.
UNIPORTAL / ADMIN FIELD GUIDEContents ↗11 / 20
04 / QUESTIONS & QUIZZES

Verify answers before activation

WHERE TO GO   /   Questions → open a question → Options / Explanation & Tags

Read the result message after saving or applying an action. A selection alone does not apply changes.

  1. Review each answer option

    For MCQ fill A–D, and E when needed. For true/false use A=True and B=False. Follow the form’s guidance for the selected type.

  2. Verify the correct answer

    Check Correct option against the source, not just the extracted text. For fill blank enter the answer there; essay answer fields remain blank.

  3. Explain and tag

    Add a useful explanation and review difficulty, year and topic tags. Scroll to Visibility, choose Active only after review, then Save.

RememberActive questions can be used by students. For several reviewed items, choose Activate selected questions in the list and Go; read the result message.
Done whenThe answer and explanation are correct and the intended questions are active.
UNIPORTAL / ADMIN FIELD GUIDEContents ↗12 / 20
04 / QUESTIONS & QUIZZES

Apply question changes carefully

WHERE TO GO   /   Questions → select rows → Actions → Set metadata for selected questions → Go

Read the result message after saving or applying an action. A selection alone does not apply changes.

  1. Confirm the selection

    The heading shows the number of questions. Expand the preview of the first five and confirm the selection before changing anything.

  2. Set only intended fields

    Choose a paper or chapter when changing those assignments. Blank fields keep their existing values; each tab has its own selection.

  3. Remove a chapter explicitly

    Use Remove existing chapter assignment only when intended. Do not also choose a new chapter.

  4. Apply or cancel

    Scroll to Apply to N selected questions. Check the count, apply, and read the result. Cancel returns without applying the edits.

RememberThe review form expires after one hour. If it expires or reports an error, return to Questions, reselect the records and review again. Do not assume a partial change succeeded.
Done whenOnly the selected questions have the intended changes, and the result message confirms success.
UNIPORTAL / ADMIN FIELD GUIDEContents ↗13 / 20
05 / STUDENTS & COMMUNICATION

Find the right student

WHERE TO GO   /   Students & communication → Find a student

Read the result message after saving or applying an action. A selection alone does not apply changes.

  1. Search by identity

    Use a name, Telegram username or Telegram ID. An exact Telegram ID is useful when names are shared by several people.

  2. Open the matching record

    Confirm identity before editing preferences or investigating a subscription. Review department, program, year and subscription details.

  3. Use the related screens

    Payment requests shows payment state. Exam records and Quiz attempts help investigate academic activity; use their own search and filters.

RememberChanging a student’s preferred department does not publish resources or move an exam paper. Use the content and exam screens for those tasks.
Done whenThe correct student is identified and you are in the screen that owns the requested change.
UNIPORTAL / ADMIN FIELD GUIDEContents ↗14 / 20
05 / STUDENTS & COMMUNICATION

Review a payment request

WHERE TO GO   /   Students & communication → Payment requests

Read the result message after saving or applying an action. A selection alone does not apply changes.

  1. Match the request

    Search by reference, student identity or payment reference. Open the request and verify amount, method and reference against actual payment records.

  2. Check the current state

    Pending requests can be approved or rejected. Approved requests have already granted access and cannot be rejected through the normal action.

  3. Select the intended action

    Select the verified rows, choose Approve & activate selected requests or Reject selected requests, then Go. Read the applied/skipped counts.

RememberUse the explicit approve/reject actions. Do not treat Reject as an undo for an approved payment or renewal; ask the owner to review a correction. Notifications are queued for delivery.
Done whenThe verified request has the intended state and the result message confirms what was changed.
UNIPORTAL / ADMIN FIELD GUIDEContents ↗15 / 20
05 / STUDENTS & COMMUNICATION

Compose an announcement

WHERE TO GO   /   Students & communication → Send broadcast

Read the result message after saving or applying an action. A selection alone does not apply changes.

  1. Write a focused message

    Check the wording, dates, course names and links. Messages are limited to 4,096 characters.

  2. Choose formatting

    Plain text is the simplest choice. If you use Markdown or HTML, verify the syntax and the final message.

  3. Preview, then open confirmation

    Use Preview to inspect the message text, then Send to All Students to open the recipient-count confirmation dialog.

RememberThis sends to every currently active student’s private bot chat. It is not a course-only audience. The text preview does not prove Telegram will accept formatting.
Done whenThe message is proofread and the confirmation dialog shows the intended audience.
UNIPORTAL / ADMIN FIELD GUIDEContents ↗16 / 20
05 / STUDENTS & COMMUNICATION

Confirm once, then track delivery

WHERE TO GO   /   Send broadcast → confirmation → Broadcast history / Message delivery

Read the result message after saving or applying an action. A selection alone does not apply changes.

  1. Read the audience count

    Confirm that a message to all active students is intended. Cancel returns to editing without sending.

  2. Confirm only when ready

    Use the dialog’s send confirmation once. The submission token prevents an identical repeated submission from creating another send batch.

  3. Follow the delivery results

    Check recent broadcast history for total, delivered, pending and failed counts. Open failed deliveries to review their errors and retry only after fixing the cause.

RememberQueued is not delivered. Do not resend the whole announcement because some recipients failed; use the failed-delivery review workflow instead.
Done whenYou can distinguish successful deliveries from pending or failed messages without creating a duplicate broadcast.
UNIPORTAL / ADMIN FIELD GUIDEContents ↗17 / 20
06 / OPERATIONS

Read the error before retrying

WHERE TO GO   /   Overview → a failed count, or Operations → the relevant process

Read the result message after saving or applying an action. A selection alone does not apply changes.

  1. Read the processing error

    Open the failed record. Identify whether the source file, size/page limit, formatting or external service caused the problem.

  2. Check previous attempts

    Review Attempt count and the source. A repeated retry will not fix the same oversized or unreadable file.

  3. Return and retry after review

    Use the matching list’s Retry failed… action only after addressing the cause. The record returns to the queue for the worker.

RememberThe current extraction limit is 100 pages. For persistent Overdue or Stale counts, contact the maintainer to check the worker and logs. Manually mark as processed does not extract text.
Done whenThe cause is understood and either a corrected retry is queued or the issue is handed to the maintainer.
UNIPORTAL / ADMIN FIELD GUIDEContents ↗18 / 20
07 / ACCESS & EVERYDAY NAVIGATION

Give each admin the access they need.

Owners manage staff accounts and groups. Everyday admins use their assigned tools and ask the owner when a task needs additional permission.

Settings → Staff accounts / Staff groups

Each person should have an individual account. Staff groups keep recurring responsibilities consistent.

For the owner

  1. Create the staff account

    Open /admin/auth/user/add/ on your admin site if Add user is not visible in the theme. Complete setup, then edit the account to enable active/staff access.

  2. Assign the appropriate group

    Use Staff groups to assign the model permissions required for the person’s tasks. Reserve superuser access for trusted owners.

  3. Check the actual staff experience

    Ask the new admin to sign in and confirm the expected menus and actions. A missing menu can be a permissions issue.

Day-to-day habitUse your own login, check the record and selection count before applying changes, and sign out on shared devices.
On a narrow screen

Use the top-left navigation button. Expand a group, then choose a screen. Escape closes the menu; Tab moves through controls. Wide tables may scroll sideways.

KEEP THIS PAGE HANDY

Your daily admin checklist.

A five-minute starting routine

  • Open Overview and inspect failed, overdue or stale work.
  • Review processed, unassigned inbox files and create drafts.
  • Finish course assignment and file review before publishing.
  • Check Resource coverage for courses with no published material.
  • Review new imports, inactive questions and the active exam term.
  • Check pending payment requests and broadcast failures when relevant.
  • Read each action result; record unresolved issues for the maintainer.
Open→Review→Apply→Verify
A useful handoverInclude the admin section, record ID, intended result, observed result and error text. Do not share passwords, bot tokens or expiring private download links.

When something feels stuck

What you seeWhat to do next
Draft will not publishAttach a file, assign an active course, review it and save. Read validation and skipped-record messages.
Upload stays queuedCheck the relevant Operations list. If work stays overdue, ask the maintainer to check the worker; do not upload repeatedly.
PDF extraction failedRead the error and source. A file over 100 pages requires review; retrying the same oversized file will not fix it.
Exam progress stops refreshingThe automatic check is bounded. Use Refresh status to check again, then open the failed import if needed.
File preview does not openTry Open file for review. Report the resource ID and observed error to the maintainer; keep an unverified file pending.
Broadcast has failuresInspect Message delivery and retry only reviewed failed records after resolving the cause. Do not resend the whole broadcast.
A menu or action is missingAsk the owner to check staff/group permissions. Also confirm that a row is selected when looking for Actions.
Bulk review has expiredReturn to Questions, select the intended rows again and open a fresh review form.

Guide based on repository interface e982e1e. Screenshots are from an isolated training instance, not live student data. Recheck the guide after interface or policy changes. Free adoption remains the current operating policy.
